Name: DanAi Haley HD Portraits for SDV
Author: Raydan00
Description:
[center][/center][center][/center][center][/center][center][size=1][/size][/center][center][size=1][/size][/center][center][size=1][/size][/center][center][size=1][/size][/center][center][size=1][/size][/center][center][size=1]I've been playing SDV for a long time and I love it, with time I also got to know the world of mods and I got addicted to almost always play it with them
(more, if we talk about aesthetic things and beautification).
Recently I also started to work with image generation AI, it's a new world for me, so I'm venturing. x'D
And to get started, I decided to try making some portraits of my favorite SDV characters,
for now I've only created these basic concepts of “Haley” (my wife in the game). x'D
I plan to continue creating more portraits for each character in the game
and learning more about how to improve with the AI.[/size]



[size=3][b]::: DESCRIPTION :::[/b][/size]
I was trying to create a portrait mod that didn't need any dependency on another mod,
but I couldn't manage it, so I ended up giving up (for now) and had to fall back on the old reliable Portraiture. x'D
So, more than a mod, it's just the portrait files of the character “Haley” SDV in a HD quality,
with a look to my liking, based on the results I could get from the AI I use.


[b][size=3]::: REQUIREMENTS :::[/size][/b]
[size=1]You will need to have installed[/size]

[size=3]1. [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]API Smapi[/url]﻿[/b]
2. [/size][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999][size=3]Portraiture[/size][/url]﻿[/b]


[b][size=3]::: INSTALLATION :::[/size][/b]
Download the main file, when you unzip it, you will get a folder called “DanAiPortraits”,
copy and paste this folder inside the “Portraits” folder of the Portraiture mod.

[size=1]- Inside the Portraiture mod, you will find a folder called “Portraits”, put the folder “DanAiPortraits” inside it and ready, you can start the game. -[/size]


~ When the game starts, while talking to someone, press the “P” key. ~
This will allow you to change or toggle character portraits.

[size=1]Sometimes, the “P” key may need to be pressed several times.[/size]


For now, I don't have a means of communication to provide as discord,
but later I will create one, if you have any questions,
you can comment in the “Posts” section here and I will try to answer as best as possible.
